title: Anonymous Commentary on Plato's Theaetetus (P.Berol. inv. 9782); RU «Анонимный комментарий к „Теэтету“»
author: Anonymous Middle Platonist
date: Composed between the 1st c. BCE and mid-2nd c. CE; papyrus 2nd c. CE
edition: Diels and Schubart, BKT II (1905), public domain: https://archive.org/details/anonymerkommenta00diel. Standard: Bastianini and Sedley, CPF III (1995), copyrighted.
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka searches ('Анонимный комментарий к Теэтету') return only studies. Absent from the translation sections of ΣΧΟΛΗ issues 2007–2026. No Russian version found.
en_evidence: The enwiki article lists only G. Boys-Stones' unpublished draft English translation (academia.edu, 2019). No published complete English translation found.
other_translations: Italian: Bastianini and Sedley, CPF III (1995). German: B. Hene, Leuven dissertation 2018 (per enwiki).
value: The earliest surviving commentary on any Platonic dialogue. Unique evidence for pre-Plotinian Platonism: an anti-Stoic critique of oikeiosis, the debate with sceptical Academics, and Theodorus' irrationals. Essential for historians of Platonism, epistemology and the commentary genre.
ai_feasibility: Medium. Compact argumentative Greek, but the papyrus has lacunae and depends on supplements. It needs a papyrologist's check, and the readings should follow CPF.
pilot_unit: Whole text (about 10k words); first stage cols. I–XI (prologue plus the oikeiosis digression), about 1.5k words.
